description: YogaQ Primary Seated Series Ground-Truth Calibrated Baseline (29 Postures)

steps.diagnostic_note: Vertical spine baseline on floor mat. Hands pressing into boardwalk mat beside hips. Uddiyana bandha locked.

steps.english: Seated Forward Bend A (Big Toe Grip)
steps.diagnostic_note: Deep forward extension over straight legs. Torso fully compressed to thighs, chin reaching beyond shins.

steps.english: Seated Forward Bend B (Outer Foot / Wrist Bind)
steps.diagnostic_note: Maximum forward fold extension. Hands clasping wrists beyond feet, ribs resting entirely on shins.
Hips lifted in line with shoulders and knees, soles grounded flat to mat, cervical extension open.
Half-lotus heel compressing into lower abdomen/navel. Reaching around back to bind big toe.
Right leg folded in Ardha Virasana beside outer hip. Even weight across both sit bones during deep fold.

steps.english: Head-to-Knee Pose A (Sole to Inner Thigh)
steps.diagnostic_note: Bent knee 90° abduction, heel at perineum. Ribs centered over straight extended leg.
Sitting directly onto heel, toes pointing forward, torso folding long over straight thigh.

steps.target_range: Torso:[75°-95°], Straight Knee:[170°-180°], Bent Ankle Inversion:[85°]
steps.diagnostic_note: Ball of foot vertical on floor, heel pressing navel, knee angled forward 45°.

steps.english: Sage Marichi Forward Fold A (Bent Knee Bind)
steps.diagnostic_note: Arm wraps shin bone tightly, hands bind behind back, chin folds toward shin.

steps.english: Sage Marichi Bound Lotus Fold B
steps.diagnostic_note: One leg in half-lotus on floor, other foot squats on mat, torso wrapped and folded.

steps.english: Sage Marichi Spinal Twist C (Bent Knee)
steps.diagnostic_note: Arm wraps around outside of vertical knee, deep thoracic spine rotation, gaze over back shoulder.

steps.english: Sage Marichi Bound Lotus Twist D
steps.diagnostic_note: Half-lotus anchor with deep contra-lateral twist. Arm binds outside opposite bent knee.

steps.english: Boat Pose — 5 Repetitions with Utpluthih Lifts
steps.diagnostic_note: 5 rounds of V-sit balance on sit bones, legs elevated 45°, interleaved with Utpluthih core lifts.
Legs wrapped around upper arms, ankles crossed, chin or forehead touching floor lightly.
Arms slide out under knees, palms facing down, chin and chest flat on boardwalk mat.

steps.english: Sleeping Tortoise Pose (Feet Bound Behind Head)
steps.diagnostic_note: Ankles crossed behind nape of neck, hands bound behind lower back, forehead grounded.

steps.english: Embryo in the Womb (9 Circular Rolls)
steps.target_range: Torso:[60°-80°], Lotus Knees:[20°-40°], Arm Threading:[Through Calf/Thigh]
steps.diagnostic_note: Arms threaded through lotus gap, holding ears/face, rolling on spine in a circle 9 times.

steps.target_range: Torso:[10°-30°], Arm Straightness:[165°-180°], Lotus Elevation:[Off Ground]
steps.diagnostic_note: Hands planted on mat, arms straight, lifting entire lotus body off the floor in pure suspension.
Soles together, knees open wide, folding forward with chest and chin to mat, crown to arches in B.
Legs wide on mat, hands grip outer feet, chin and chest fully resting on boardwalk mat.
Roll up and balance squarely on sit bones, legs wide in the air, head thrown back gazing up.

steps.target_range: Torso:[80°-100°], Knee:[170°-180°], Overhead Touchdown:[Feet on Floor]
steps.diagnostic_note: Roll overhead onto shoulders, feet wide touching floor, hold big toes, then roll straight up.

steps.english: Reclining Big Toe Stretch (Vertical Shin Touch)
steps.diagnostic_note: Supine on mat, hold right big toe, lift head and torso to touch chin to vertical shin.
Leg opens out to side while left hip stays glued to mat. Finishes with Chakrasana backward somersault.

steps.english: Both Big Toes Balance (V-Sit Balance Roll)
steps.diagnostic_note: Roll from supine straight into balanced V-sit holding both big toes, straight legs, head tilted up.
Hands bind wrists beyond feet, torso compressed tight to thighs in balanced vertical fold.

steps.english: Bridge Pose (Resting on Crown of Head)
steps.diagnostic_note: Weight supported between crown of head and feet, arms crossed across chest, hips pressed high.
5 full wheels, stand-up drop-backs, followed by essential calming 15-breath Paschimottanasana counter-fold.
